name: @unimsg/android
description: Android shell: Capacitor WebView (apps/ui) + the TypeScript backend inside the app via nodejs-mobile

scripts.test: tsx --test src/notify.test.ts src/warm-pause.test.ts && node scripts/persist-test.mjs && node scripts/build-backend-bundle.mjs --smoke
scripts.sync: pnpm run ui && pnpm run bundle && cap sync android
scripts.debug: pnpm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.release: pnpm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
